content.text: h07. **Chain: browser `` → `/file/users/{username}/avatar` → SQL `SELECT avatar_url FROM user`** ``` UserAvatar () — web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx:12 convertUserFromStore (rewrites base64 avatar to "/file/users/{username}/avatar") — server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:16,36 FileServerService.RegisterRoutes (GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124 FileServerService.serveUserAvatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 FileServerService.getCurrentUser → Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser (private-instance gate only) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708 → server/auth/authenticator.go:190 FileServerService.getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715 Store.GetUser — store/user.go:148 Store.ListUsers — store/user.go:136 Driver.ListUsers (interface) — store/driver.go:47 DB.ListUsers (SELECT ... avatar_url FROM user WHERE username = ?) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (also store/db/postgres/user.go:87, store/db/mysql/user.go:84) FileServerService.parseDataURI (base64-decode the stored data URI) → c.Blob — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737, 196-209 ``` Notes on the hops that matter: - **The image bytes live in the `user.avatar_url` column**, not on disk or S3 — they're stored as a `data:;base64,...` URI (`dataURIRegex`, fileserver.go:98). The API deliberately does *not* ship that base64 blob in the user proto; it swaps in the `/file/...` URL (user_service_converters.go:31-38), which is why the browser makes a second request at all. - **The path segment is the username**, not the user ID: `BuildUserName(user.Username)` produces `users/{username}`, so `/file/%s/avatar` yields `/file/users/{username}/avatar`, and the handler resolves it via `FindUser{Username: &identifier}` (fileserver.go:716). - **The user cache is bypassed on this path.** `Store.GetUser` only consults `s.userCache` when `find.ID != nil` (store/user.go:149-156); a username lookup always falls through to `ListUsers` → driver → SQL, then populates the cache keyed by ID. - **Authorization**: for *another user's* avatar there is no per-user permission check. Access is gated only by `s.Profile.AllowAnonymous()` (fileserver.go:173) — on a public instance anyone may fetch any user's avatar; on a private instance any authenticated session/PAT suffices. MIME type is then restricted to `avatarAllowedTypes` (fileserver.go:75-83, 201) before `c.Blob`. - Routes are registered before the gRPC-gateway in `server/server.go:81-82`, so `/file/*` never reaches the API v1 gateway.
